articles.title: Bitcoin rebounds above $60,000 after $1.8 billion crypto liquidation wave
articles.snippet: The selloff wiped out $1.8 billion in leveraged crypto positions, mostly from bullish bets on rising prices.

articles.title: XRP falls 10% as long bets unwind and ETF assets slip below $1 billion
articles.snippet: The token broke its previous November lows during Saturday's crypto selloff, with long positions accounting for most XRP liquidations and technical indicators showing further weakness.

articles.title: Bitcoin tanks below $57,000 for the first time in two years, and its not alone
articles.snippet: BTC's sell-off deepened on Saturday, with prices hitting two-year lows under $57,000.

articles.title: Live news: Bitcoin slips to fresh lows below $59,000 as Anthropic slides after Nasdaq debut
articles.snippet: BlackRock’s bitcoin ETF saw a record $541.1 million outflow as the U.S. tech selloff spread to Asia, sending South Korea’s Kospi down more than 5%.

articles.title: No special rules for Hyperliquid or other onchain trading platforms, CFTC says
articles.snippet: Hyperliquid and other onchain exchanges can offer derivatives to U.S. traders if they obtain the required licenses or work with a registered exchange, the CFTC chairman said.
